sourceText: 继续开发 ProofStory acceptance topology 执行计划的全部剩余 Wave，直到每个所需 Story 进入 DONE；当前 Story 实现 Wave 1A 独立派生 coverage basis。
normalizedOutcome: 用户运行 acceptance_basis 只读命令时能看到由注册 verifier 独立派生、签名并绑定当前 workspace/scope/story/closure 的 complete/partial/unsupported 报告，任何遗漏、分歧、陈旧或篡改均明确失败关闭。
acceptanceClaim: Wave 1A verifier independently derives and signs a replayable coverage basis; callers cannot author completeness, and omission/tampering/disagreement/stale mutations bite deterministically.
